title: Record L2.9 equivalence and exact-inventory IntegrationAdapter absence decisions
goal: Make both user-selected A decisions explicit, source-bound and invalidatable without weakening the C1k detector.
acceptanceCriteria: The L2.9 decision retains the exact V3 null-module predicate and identifies the structural fallback and re-review triggers.

The IntegrationAdapter zero-subject exception binds an exact src project path-and-content inventory and current V3 policy/implementation hashes; an executable verifier rejects added, removed or modified projects and any adapter match.
Positive and negative controls, Formal Pre/Diff, isolated IFX package regression and published Package identity checks pass; no production Profile is accepted.
